exposure: Antepartum intravenous iron sucrose (IVFe) administration (timing before delivery and number of doses)
outcome: Predelivery hemoglobin (Hb) increase from third trimester
cohort: Pregnant women with a third-trimester hemoglobin < 9.5 g/dL, who obtained prenatal care and delivered at the study institution between October 2015 and October 2017, were included, with exclusions for hemoglobinopathies and antepartum blood transfusions.
finding: Antepartum intravenous iron sucrose effectively increases hemoglobin levels from the third trimester to delivery when administered 2-12 weeks predelivery, with greater benefit observed with earlier administration and more doses.
